findings.summary: `rules += active_promos(now)` mutates the list cached by lru_cache in load_rules, so promos accumulate across quotes (stacking discounts, persisting after expiry, unbounded growth, and leaking into the API rules endpoint).
save_rules calls load_rules.cache_clear(), clearing every tenant's cache on any single tenant's write, which is wasteful; a per-tenant cache would be more precise.
The cache is per process with no TTL, so writes from other processes/workers or directly in the DB leave this process serving stale rules indefinitely.
The last line of test_save_invalidates_cache writes to the DB without asserting anything and leaves state behind for other tests, looking like a missed cleanup/restore.
No test calls price_quote, so the cache-mutation bug is not caught; a test calling price_quote twice and checking the discount is unchanged is needed.
